title: Phase 4 (adaptive suggestions): keep or cut? (D-6)
detail: Phase 4 would log every time you overrule the score (hold a top job, pursue a low one) with your reason code, then offer suggestions such as "you declined 8 of 10 Chicago roles scoring above 70; lower Chicago geo?". Advisory only, opt-in, reversible; it never changes the shared model or rules by itself.
blocks: Nothing; it is the last phase.
recommended: Keep only the reason-code logging (already in Phase 3, T-19); cut the suggestion engine.
action: Answer in chat with the option you want; Claude records it in asks/resolved/.
